full_sentence: She enjoys reading novels in the evening.
acceptable_variants: walking in the park after work.

options.text: to read novels in the evening.
options.why_wrong: 'Enjoy' is followed by a gerund (-ing form), not an infinitive with 'to'.
'Enjoy' needs a gerund; a bare verb without -ing is ungrammatical here.
The stem already contains the verb 'enjoys', so a second finite verb cannot follow it directly.

explanation: The verb 'enjoy' is always followed by a gerund. Learners may expect an infinitive here because many other verbs take 'to', so the -ing pattern after 'enjoy' should be learned as a fixed pattern.
